desc: Parse input, compute first[v] and last[v] occurrence for each value v in 1..N.
Compute prefix distinct array P[i] (i=1..N) and suffix distinct array S[i] (distinct count of A[i..N]).
Group intervals by last occurrence: for each value v, record (first[v]-1) at bucket[last[v]] meaning when sweep reaches j=last[v], do range add +1 on i in [1, first[v]-1].
Build a lazy segment tree over i=1..N-1 initialized with values P[i]; support range add and range max on [1, j-1].
Sweep j=2..N-1: apply pending range-adds for bucket[j], then candidate = query_max(1, j-1) + S[j+1]; track global max.
Edge-check small cases (N=3, all equal values, all distinct), then output the answer; verify against samples mentally (5 and 9).
